purpose: Selected-row performance and same-backend arithmetic checks on Apple Silicon. Raw synthetic inputs have no quality labels; this is not MMLU, calibration, or a quality-matched Jev comparison.
source_note: Timed Apple implementation is commit 69d0be5e1ca1670e78310d922d2fd2992ba5926a; samples were collected while that implementation was being committed. Metadata captures the observed HEAD/status and exact binary hash. The subsequent Scalar-resolver delegation guard fixes unsupported x86 capability only; measured NEON/Metal row arithmetic is unchanged. The final Scalar registry-name guard removes an exported resolver-address relocation for Linux FFI without changing the timed Apple kernels.

host.conditions: Shared desktop, no CPU pinning, temperature/power control or forced cache eviction. No own builds/tests overlapped final timed runs. Small repeated samples do not support fine-grained performance-regression claims.

head_microbenchmark.fixture: Resolved native projection only, four spread aligned tiles; full dense projection then map versus selected tiles then map. Same input and storage arithmetic. Means of ten warm repeats, not p50. Model-sized geometries are synthetic.
head_microbenchmark.source_note: Final standalone head run after the Scalar delegation capability fix; the recorded binary SHA256 identifies the executable actually timed.

ordinary_generation_sweeps.protocol: bench_perf_sweep: initial lengths 32/128, decode 8, warmup 8, repeats 3; confirmation length 32, decode 8, warmup 8, repeats 5, reverse process order. OMP_NUM_THREADS=6, OMP_WAIT_POLICY=passive, GEIST_TEXT_ONLY=1. Default greedy generation; model file and backend match decision runs.
ordinary_generation_sweeps.interpretation: Run-to-run drift is visible, especially in Bonsai CPU decode during the first sweep. The confirmation samples and bit-identical generation checks are retained; these ratios do not establish a normal-generation speedup.

ordinary_generation_byte_parity.prompt: Hello this is a repeatable generation regression probe.

optimized_disassembly.note: Extracting normalization/rotation adds one helper call and its prologue/epilogue (20 glue instructions overall). Projection kernels and their arithmetic are unchanged. Ordinary generation parity and sweeps cover the resulting path.

verification.gcc: GCC 16 optimized -O3 compilation of changed portable production files and adversarial non-finite runtime tests
verification.headers: 7 public headers in C23/C++17; 18 stable API contract symbols
verification.real_models: Qwen and Bonsai CPU/Metal exact logits; Gemma real softcap Metal release/ASan; full ordinary logits and 8 generated token IDs before/after byte-identical on all three models, both backends
verification.allocations: Every timed warm selected row kernel has zero geist heap allocations; private candidate/tile workspace is allocated at creation. Existing backbone high-water buffers can warm on first use.
verification.memory: Reported decision process RSS includes its model and concurrent retained generation/DENSE/selected handles. It is not per-handle or complete GPU memory usage. Dense architecture scratch remains reserved.
verification.linux_ffi: Linux ARM64, GCC 14.4.0, native GEMM, -fPIE matching Ubuntu compiler defaults: decision API/error and selected-tile fixtures pass; whole-archive shared-library link and Python ctypes load/decision availability pass. Cached offline Docker container.
